title: Shopify Agentic Storefronts — per-channel eligibility and capability matrix
description: Which AI channels Shopify Agentic Storefronts covers, who is eligible for each, whether checkout happens in-conversation or on the merchant's own store, and which product types, fulfilment methods and tracking pixels work in each path. Every field is sourced to Shopify's own documentation.
note: Checkout behaviour inverted in March 2026. ChatGPT launched with in-conversation Instant Checkout and now redirects to the merchant's own checkout; Google, Copilot and Meta carry direct checkout. Guidance published before 24 March 2026 describes the opposite arrangement and is stale.

channels.name: ChatGPT
channels.checkoutDetail: Shoppers complete the purchase on the merchant's own Shopify checkout, opened in the ChatGPT in-app browser or a new tab on web.
channels.customerLocationRule: Must sell to customers in the United States
channels.storeLocationQuote: Your store must sell to customers in the United States, however, your store can be based outside the United States.
notes: Legal disclosures must appear within the first 6,000 characters of the product description.
Opting out can take up to 7 days to take effect.

channels.name: Google AI Mode & Gemini
channels.checkoutDetail: Checkout completes inside Google's interface. Direct checkout renders only for US-based customers; everyone else is redirected to the merchant's store.
channels.storeLocationRule: United States, United Kingdom, Australia or Canada
channels.customerLocationRule: Must sell to customers in one of those four countries
channels.storeLocationQuote: Your store must be based in the United States, the United Kingdom, Australia, or Canada, and you must sell to customers in one of those countries.
notes: Early access — not yet available to all eligible stores.
Requires the Google & YouTube sales channel with product and shipping sync enabled.

channels.name: Microsoft Copilot
channels.checkoutDetail: Copilot Checkout completes the purchase inside Copilot.
channels.customerLocationRule: Must sell to customers in the United States
channels.storeLocationQuote: all eligible stores that sell to customers in the United States

channels.name: Meta AI (Facebook & Instagram)
channels.customerLocationRule: Must sell to customers in the United States
channels.storeLocationQuote: all eligible stores that sell to customers in the United States

channels.name: Perplexity
channels.checkoutDetail: In-chat buying on Perplexity runs on PayPal Instant Buy. Those orders are managed through PayPal, not the Shopify admin, and the merchant applies to the Perplexity Merchant Program separately.
channels.storeLocationRule: Not governed by Shopify Agentic Storefronts
channels.customerLocationRule: Not governed by Shopify Agentic Storefronts
channels.storeLocationQuote: those orders are managed through PayPal rather than your Shopify admin
channels.fee: Set by PayPal / Perplexity, not Shopify
notes: Perplexity appeared in Shopify's December 2025 launch announcement and is no longer listed as an Agentic Storefronts channel in the help documentation.
Guides that list Perplexity as a Shopify agentic channel with redirect checkout are describing an arrangement that does not exist.

directCheckoutLimits.whyNot: ChatGPT sends the shopper to the merchant's own Shopify checkout, so the merchant's normal checkout rules, extensions and client-side pixels all apply as usual.
unsupportedCheckoutFeatures: A subset of accelerated checkout options

discounts.quote: Any automatic discounts or discount codes that you set up are supported in agentic storefront direct checkouts.

pixels.quote: Google Analytics and custom pixels won't fire in all agentic storefront direct checkouts. The checkouts fire only server-to-server pixels (started, completed), so none of the standard or custom client side pixels fire.

knowledgeBaseApp.name: Shopify Knowledge Base
knowledgeBaseApp.priceNote: The App Store listing shows no paid tier and no Plus-only carve-out. Claims of a monthly fee for standard plans could not be sourced to any Shopify page and appear to conflate this app with third-party knowledge-base apps.
knowledgeBaseApp.quote: Your FAQs aren't displayed directly on your storefront — instead, they serve as a trusted data source for AI platforms.

timeline.event: Shopify Knowledge Base app published to the Shopify App Store.
Agentic Storefronts announced in Shopify's Winter '26 Edition.
General availability for eligible US merchants. OpenAI retires ChatGPT Instant Checkout the same day; ChatGPT becomes a discovery-focused referrer that redirects to the merchant's own checkout.
Spring '26 Edition opens UCP and MCP access to all developers without prior approval.

changes: Corrected the checkout model per channel after the 24 March 2026 inversion: ChatGPT redirects, Google/Copilot/Meta carry direct checkout.
Removed the claim that the Knowledge Base app costs a monthly fee on standard plans — the App Store listing shows it as free.
Removed Perplexity as a Shopify agentic channel; it runs on PayPal Instant Buy outside the Shopify admin.
Reversed the discount-code claim: automatic discounts and discount codes are both supported.
Added Meta as a direct-checkout channel and added digital, customizable and B2B-only products to the unsupported list.
Corrected the announcement date from January 2026 to 10 December 2025, and added the March and June 2026 milestones.
